observation.visible_scene: A small golden spoon-shaped dish with a dark green handle rests on a white circular metal stand. Inside the dish sit several colorful molded pieces—white and pink flowers, a red cube, a purple cube, and a cluster of translucent beads. A small flame glows directly beneath the dish. The background shows checkered fabric and white lace, and the whole setup stays in the same position throughout.
visible_changes: The molded pieces progressively lose their sharp, solid edges and become partially submerged in a growing pool of glossy golden/clear liquid, i.e. they melt and slump in place.
The white flower pieces soften and merge into the liquid first; the red, pink and purple shapes then blur and sink as the pool expands.
The flame under the dish flickers in brightness/size but remains present the whole time.
The dish, handle, stand and background do not move, indicating a stationary camera rather than object translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the melting began and what the pieces looked like before this segment.
The final fully-melted state after the clip ends.
The exact heat source and its fuel.
uncertain_details: Material identity of the pieces (wax melts vs. gelatin-like shapes) is not confirmed visually.
Whether the apparent liquid rise is added volume from melting or the pieces simply sinking into existing melt.
Precise flame behavior frame-to-frame is hard to read due to glare.
